violations.reason: Evidence describes anti-GD1b auto-antibody (protein/assay reagent) as the biomarker, not GD1b glycan itself. The glycan name is incorrectly used as the biomarker when evidence explicitly links antibody levels to disease. Direction cannot be supported for the glycan entity.

metrics.name: AUC
metrics.raw: area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.95

details.notes: All mappings are exact matches: GD1b corresponds to GSD000084 (exact glycan structure), Huntington's disease maps to DOID:12858 (exact disease concept), plasma maps to UBERON:0001969 (exact biofluid term), and human maps to NCBI Taxonomy ID 9606. No forced mappings or semantic approximations were applied.
